All tests pass. Here's a summary of the implementation in `server.mjs`:

## What was built

A support ticket MCP server exposing a single `ticket_create` tool.

### `listTools()`
Returns the `ticket_create` tool definition with an explicit JSON Schema input schema:
- `title` (string, required) — short summary
- `description` (string, required) — detailed description
- `priority` (string enum `low`/`normal`/`high`, default `normal`)
- `required: ["title", "description"]`
- `additionalProperties: false` — no extra fields

### `callTool(name, args)`
- **Unknown tool name** → throws `Unknown tool: <name>` (which the protocol layer surfaces as a JSON-RPC error).
- **Non-object args / unknown argument** → rejected (enforces "no extra fields").
- **`title` / `description`** must be present and non-empty strings.
- **`priority`** optional; defaults to `normal`; must be one of the three enum values.
- Generates **stable sequential ticket IDs** via a module-level counter (`t1`, `t2`, …).
- Returns a concise text result, e.g. `Created ticket t1: Bug (priority: normal)`.

### Verified behaviors
- Required non-empty `title`/`description` ✓
- Optional `priority` enum with `normal` default ✓
- Rejects extra fields, bad enum values, empty required fields, and unknown tools ✓
- Sequential IDs (`t1`, `t2`, `t3`) ✓
- Full test suite (`npm test`) passes ✓

The change was contained entirely to `server.mjs`, leaving `protocol.mjs` (the JSON-RPC readline loop) untouched since it already correctly routes to `listTools`/`callTool` and converts thrown errors into JSON-RPC error responses.
